source_documents.title: Mechanical Insights into Aggregation-Induced Delayed Fluorescence Materials with Anti-Kasha Behavior

reference_evidence_units.quote: The coopera- tive effect of these weak hydrogen bonds can rigidify molecular conformation and restrict intramolecular motion
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMF-BP-PXZ crystal
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Single crystal grown from THF/ethanol; Figure 1; PXZ-phenylene torsion about 86 degrees.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors assign weak C-H...pi/C-H...O contacts to rigidification and motion restriction; no obvious pi stacking is found.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Packing-to-RIM attribution is interpretive, not independently isolated by a contact-specific intervention.

reference_evidence_units.subject: DMF-BP-PXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 1 visually inspected; THF 10^-5 M versus deposited neat/doped films; room temperature under nitrogen.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Solution: 595 nm, 2.6% PLQY, 2.3 ns. Neat film: 548 nm, 45.4%, prompt 30.2 ns/delayed 1.4 microseconds. Doped film: 534 nm, 73.4%, prompt 31.0 ns/delayed 2.1 microseconds.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Distinct environments; not comparator rows. These values do not independently establish which singlet state emits.

reference_evidence_units.quote: these molecules have close kF values in solutions and in neat films
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMF-BP-PXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Experiment-derived rate model, Table 2 visually inspected, solution versus neat film.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Target kF is 11.1 versus 10.6 x10^6 s^-1, while kIC falls from 41.7 to 1.3 x10^7 s^-1. Film kISC is 9.7 x10^6 and kRISC 1.0 x10^6 s^-1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Derived rates, not direct independent rate measurements. SI equations not inspected; near-constant kF argues against radiative-rate enhancement as the principal cause.

reference_evidence_units.quote: a broad excited-state absorption (ESA) band in the range of 800–1000 nm can be observed in neat film
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMF-BP-PXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Nanosecond transient absorption, deaerated THF versus vacuum-deposited film, 410 nm excitation; monitor 940 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Film ESA lifetime is 1413.3 ns, near the 1.4 microsecond delayed PL lifetime. THF has no corresponding triplet-indicating signal.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Triplet assignment is the authors' interpretation of ESA; absence of detectable signal is not proof of exactly zero ISC.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the oscillator strength of S1 is almost zero (f = 0.0006)
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMF-BP-PXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: DFT/TDDFT; crystal-based QM/MM two-layer ONIOM with rigid surroundings, BMK/6-31G(d) initial calculation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Computed S1 is nearly dark; other functionals also gave nearly zero S1 oscillator strength according to the main text.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Approximate model; SI functional comparisons not directly inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the emission wavelength of DMF-BP-PXZ in solid calculated with the PBE0 functional is 525 nm with a relatively large f value of 0.0523
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMF-BP-PXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Optimized S2 in solid-state model; comparison to crystal emission at 525 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: A brighter S2 transition matches the cited crystal peak, supporting the authors' anti-Kasha assignment.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Crystal peak is distinct from 548 nm neat-film peak. Calculation-based state assignment, not direct experimental state-resolved proof.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Since it is difficult for us to obtain the exact value of kIC of S2 → S1 by calculation
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMF-BP-PXZ
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Model nonradiative pathway in solution and solid.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors substitute S1-to-S0 kIC for the full S2-to-S1-to-S0 process; resulting values are 3.1 x10^10 s^-1 in solution and 8.8 x10^6 s^-1 in solid.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The uncalculated S2-to-S1 step is an explicit model limitation, especially for a claim of competing S2 fluorescence.

reference_evidence_units.quote: As for S2, it is a typical CT state
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMF-BP-PXZ S2 and T3
reference_evidence_units.conditions: NTO analysis in THF and solid.
reference_evidence_units.statement: S2 is assigned CT from dimethylfluorene to benzoyl; T3 has significant locally excited character.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Not a demonstrated TICT or separate PET reaction.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the energy gap between S2 and T3 is so small (0.22 eV) in solid
reference_evidence_units.subject: DMF-BP-PXZ
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors identify S2-to-T3 as dominant ISC and T3-to-S2 as RISC; calculated kRISC is 7.2 x10^4 s^-1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This differs from experiment-derived 1.0 x10^6 s^-1 in Table 2; do not present the two rates as quantitatively identical.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the intramolecular motions are restricted greatly, and thus the nonradiative IC channels are blocked
reference_evidence_units.subject: Three AIDF emitters including DMF-BP-PXZ
reference_evidence_units.statement: Restricted motions suppress competing IC, allowing ISC/RISC and delayed fluorescence to become prominent.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A bounded source mechanistic account. This does not establish conical intersections or aggregate-exciton emission.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source explicitly links motion restriction to reduced IC and emergence of delayed emission.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Crystal contacts and solid physical constraints enable the RIM pathway; overlapping, not an independent cause.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: S2 CT character is calculated by NTO analysis.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Dark S1/bright S2 and experimentally derived IC/ISC competition support state/rate balance; radiative rate itself scarcely increases and S2 IC is approximated.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Delayed PL, triplet-assigned ESA and ISC/RISC model support triplet-mediated delayed fluorescence.

reference_mechanisms.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Retain authors' computed S2 emission assignment with explicit limitations on uncomputed S2-to-S1 IC and approximate QM/MM.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Source explicitly links motion restriction to reduced IC and emergence of delayed emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Crystal contacts and solid physical constraints enable the RIM pathway; overlapping, not an independent cause.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific binding of a guest, solvent or analyte that alters emission established.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: S2 CT character is calculated by NTO analysis.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer pathway established; hydrogen bonding or an OH substituent alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; CT-state character is not by itself a separate PET process.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton, excimer or exciplex emission established; aggregation alone does not establish this family.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Dark S1/bright S2 and experimentally derived IC/ISC competition support state/rate balance; radiative rate itself scarcely increases and S2 IC is approximated.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Delayed PL, triplet-assigned ESA and ISC/RISC model support triplet-mediated delayed fluorescence.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No conical-intersection-mediated nonradiative pathway established for this target in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Retain authors' computed S2 emission assignment with explicit limitations on uncomputed S2-to-S1 IC and approximate QM/MM.
